scientific_limitations: Synthetic truth is generated by the same frozen model family with small noise; G2-G4 synthetic passes establish execution/identifiability plausibility, not biological truth.
C000 is a frozen generic matched comparator, not a population-estimated model; population wording must not be inferred from the internal variable label.

The empirical predictor is a candidate-specific four-band vector from one generic 4.096-second drive, repeated across epochs; the result concerns average spectral-feature consistency, not epoch-specific dynamic prediction.
The empirical bootstrap resamples epochs as exchangeable and does not model within-night serial dependence; the interval is valid only under the prospectively frozen epoch-bootstrap estimand.
Independent reproduction is blind role/process independence using the same frozen code, data, and environment, not an independent implementation or cross-platform replication.
One public subject and one Night-1 recording cannot identify population generalization or empirical wrong-subject specificity.
